The modern desert approach

Yards designed for the desert — and built to stay sharp

In the East Valley a thirsty lawn is a losing battle. We design clean, modern desert yards that look great on far less water and hold up to the Queen Creek heat, year after year.

Designed, not just planted

We plan the whole yard first — turf, pavers, plantings and grade — so the finished space looks considered and works together, not thrown in piece by piece.

Low-water, low-upkeep

Artificial turf, drought-tolerant plants and rock groundcover keep a yard green and tidy without the weekly mow or the summer water bill.

Built to last

Pavers and travertine set on a proper base, turf laid clean and edges finished right — the details that keep a yard looking new for years.

What we do

Full-service desert landscaping

From a stock builder yard to a finished modern desert space — and everything in between. Real work we do across Queen Creek and the East Valley.

01

Drought-tolerant desert design

Complete modern desert yards: gravel and decomposed granite, boulders and dry accents, and low-water desert plants and cactus laid out to fit your home.

  • Boulders & rock

02

Artificial turf & putting greens

Crisp, low-maintenance artificial turf lawns and custom backyard putting greens that stay green all year without irrigation or mowing.

  • Turf lawns
  • Putting greens
  • Pet-friendly turf
03

Pavers & travertine

Paver and travertine patios, walkways and pool decking set on a compacted base to drain and stay flat — clean lines that pull a yard together.

  • Paver patios
  • Travertine
  • Walkways
04

Full yard transformations

Front- and backyard makeovers start to finish — design, hardscape, turf and planting handled by one crew, from a bare lot to a finished space.
